system.description:
You gain access to Unleashed Abilities. If you have the Force Sensitivity Feat, you also gain access to Force Unleashed Abilities.

Prerequisites: Have a Destiny, Receive the Gamemaster's Approval

Effect: You can activate Unleashed Abilities by spending a Destiny Point. You must also have the Force Sensitivity Feat in order to activate Force Unleashed Abilities for Force Powers and Force Talents.
